To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we synthesized a series of 11 novel 123I-iodinated triazole-substitued imidazo[1.2-a]pyridine probes for SPECT imaging of β-aminoid plaques in AD-affected brain.

a series of 123I-labled triazole substituted 2-pheny- or 2-pyryl- imidazo[1.2-a]pyridine derivative were synthesized, evaluated for their in vitro affinity to Aβ aggregates and in vitro autoradiography in the hippocampi of AD affected brain, and evaluated in vivo in rats.
we synthesized and evaluated a series of 11 2-pheny- and 2-(pyridin-3-yl)-1,2,4-triazole-sub-stituted imidazopyridines as potential imaging probes for SPECT-based detection of Aβ plaques.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel 123I-labled probes for imaging Aβ deposits in AD.

the design and synthesis of new 2-phenylimidazo[1-2-a]pyridine and 2-pyr-idyl-imidazo- [1,2-a]py-ridine derivatives as potential SPECT imaging probes for Aβ plaques and the evaluation of the in vitro and in vivo properties of the most promising compounds.
the development of new imaging agents for the detection and diagnosis of AD.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work has provided a novel class of 2-aryl-imidazo[ 1,2-a]pyridines with potential for SPECT imaging of Aβ plaques.
the 123I-labled 2-phenylimidazopyridines and 2-pyrildylimidazopyrides are suitable probes for imaging Aβ in the brain of Alzheimer's patients.
the compound [123I]IPI-291 is a good candidate to be further developed as a radioligand for the SPECT imaging of Aβ plaques.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 1 H-2-pyridylimidazopyridines are a new class of compounds that bind with high selectivity and affinity to Aβ aggregates.
the 123I-labled triazole-substitued 2-pyrdyl-imidazo-pyridine derivatives showed high selectivity and good kinetics in rat model.
we have developed and evaluated a novel class of SPECT probes for the imaging of Aβ in AD affected brain.
The main takeaway from our work is that
1 H-3,4,5-triazole-substitution on 2-pyridoimidazopyridine derivatives may be a useful structural motif for the development of SPECT probes for imaging Aβ in AD.
123I-ABC577 is an effective imaging probe for Aβ plaques that is well suited for SPECT imaging.
we have synthesized a series of 123I-labled 2-pyrimidine-imidazopyrimidine derivatives and evaluated their potential to serve as SPECT probes for imaging Aβ in AD affected brains.
